name: PostHog
label: PostHog — capture, flags, persons, insights
description: Official PostHog Capture (POST /i/v0/e/) + Flags (/flags?v=2) + private REST persons/insights. Default ingest https://us.i.posthog.com (EU: https://eu.i.posthog.com). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Customer owns the PostHog project. Minimize: send only distinct_id and event fields needed. api_key is never logged or returned.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets (api_key, personal_api_key) here. Example: {"operation":"event.capture"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'event.capture' | 'identify.create' | 'alias.create' | 'track.page' | 'track.screen' | 'person.get' | 'insight.get' | 'featureFlag.isEnabled'.

schema.label: event
schema.description: Event name for event.capture. For identify.create use $identify; alias.create $create_alias; track.page $pageview; track.screen $screen.

schema.label: distinct_id
schema.description: Person distinct id (max 200 chars). Required for capture/flags. Do not log emails stored as distinct_id.

schema.label: properties
schema.description: Event properties. Do not put the project token here.

schema.label: events
schema.description: Batch payload for capture; each item {event, distinct_id, properties?, timestamp?}. Whole body must be < 20 MB.

schema.label: insight_id
schema.description: insight.get path id. Required for insight.get.

schema.label: flag_key
schema.description: featureFlag.isEnabled: if set, interpret that flag; else full flags map.

schema.label: project_id
schema.description: Overrides config project_id for private REST paths.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. PII may be present — do not log bodies.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: event.capture | identify.create | alias.create | track.page | track.screen | person.get | insight.get | featureFlag.isEnabled.

configurationParameters.label: Host
configurationParameters.description: Instance origin interpolated as OfficialApiNode baseUrl. US ingest https://us.i.posthog.com; EU ingest https://eu.i.posthog.com; app hosts https://us.posthog.com / https://eu.posthog.com for person.get / insight.get; self-host the operator URL (no trailing slash).

configurationParameters.label: Project API key
configurationParameters.description: PostHog project token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as query api_key. Official capture also accepts JSON body api_key. Never log or place on INPUT. Project settings on the PostHog app host.

configurationParameters.label: Personal API key
configurationParameters.description: Personal API key for private REST (person.get / insight.get). Sent as Authorization: Bearer on those operations. Never on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Project id
configurationParameters.description: Numeric project id for person.get / insight.get path /api/projects/{project_id}/….

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 uses api_spec default. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
